extractionStatus.css: Read and measured; CSS layer names and coordinates are the source of truth.
extractionStatus.svg: Original SVG source is available and the verified component exporter produces source-derived crops. 25 SVG artwork crops have been rendered and mapped into PixArtwork Painter slots; raster files are supplied as a drawable-nodpi resource pack.

mappingPolicy: Layer names below are exact CSS labels. SVG asset binding is performed by passing the matching exported group as a Painter to PixArtwork; missing painters intentionally render no substitute.

profileScreen.Subtle profile header glow: Compose radial gradient using the CSS stops
profileScreen.Profile avatar: Compose circle; fill and border from CSS

sourceExport.status: The first-pass and component exporters are implemented. 25 verified component crops were generated from the uploaded original SVG and supplied in a drawable-nodpi WebP resource pack; binary assets are not committed to the repository.
sourceExport.bindingStatus: PixScreens.kt consumes screen-specific gift-action and credit-lightning painters plus the original Agent robot artwork. PixArtworkResources.kt loads the named drawable-nodpi resources. Copy the supplied WebP files to the Android app resources before calling rememberPixArtwork().
sourceExport.validationBoundary: Source node selection and raster crops are verified against the original full-frame SVG renders. Android resource compilation and on-device Compose screenshot parity are not verified in this repository because it has no Gradle app module.
